label: documented for version
type: the product version whose documentation tree the subject's page ships in. NOT a claim that the subject is new in, or gated by, that version.
note: The most useful single distinction this round produced, and the direct antidote to the round's one fabrication: prepare.json asserted 'availableSince version:server-8-0' for a feature its page never dates, on no stronger basis than the page living in the 8.0 tree. Batch B independently reached the opposite discipline - it minted this predicate precisely so that 'I know which tree I read this in' could be recorded without being upgraded into 'I know when this appeared'. Keep the two strictly separate: availableSince requires the page to state a version; this requires only that the page exist. Six of the six wave-1 occurrences are transaction-statement pages that state no version at all.
